home.title: AeleOS
home.body: One account for every app in the community. Sign in once and you are already signed in everywhere.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the account you already have.
signIn.error: We could not open that option. Please try again.

profile.platformIdHint: This ID is the same in every Furry Colombia app.
profile.addressHint: This is where your public profile lives. Share it, or open it to see what others see.
profile.failed: That did not save. Try again.
profile.privateHint: Your profile page is private. Publishing it does not change your fursonas — each of those has its own setting.

fursonas.title: Your fursonas
fursonas.subtitle: The characters you can act as across Furry Colombia.
fursonas.suspended: Your account is suspended, so your fursonas are not available right now and no new ones can be created. Nothing has been deleted.

form.handleHint: Letters, digits, dash and underscore. This is how the fursona is addressed.

errors.handle: Use 1–32 letters, digits, dashes or underscores.
errors.handleTaken: You already have a fursona with that handle.
errors.displayName: Keep this to 64 characters or fewer.
errors.avatarUrl: Enter an http or https image address, or leave it empty.
errors.limitReached: You already have the maximum number of fursonas.
errors.sectionsRefused: Your sections were refused. Fix them and save again — nothing else was lost.

fursonas.writingInHint: Only the name and the page text below — not the app itself.
fursonas.sectionsEmpty: No sections yet. Add one to start building the page.
fursonas.sectionsAtLimit: You have reached the maximum number of sections.
fursonas.linkUrlHint: A YouTube, Vimeo, Spotify or SoundCloud link plays here. Anything else becomes a button.
fursonas.templateConfirm: This replaces the sections you have now. What you wrote will be gone.

reference-sheet.name: Reference sheet
reference-sheet.description: The facts an artist asks for: species, pronouns, age, and how the design works.

character-story.name: Character story
character-story.description: Who they are and where they came from, with room for the small details.

art-gallery.name: Art gallery
art-gallery.description: Somewhere to show the pictures, with credit to whoever drew them.

fursuit.name: Fursuit
fursuit.description: The suit itself — who built it, what of, and where it has been.

fursonas.imageTooLarge: That file is over 2 MB. Choose a smaller one.
fursonas.imageWrongType: That is not an image we can store. Use PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
fursonas.imageFailed: The upload did not work. Try again.
fursonas.imageStaysPublic: An uploaded picture stays reachable by its address, even if you make this fursona private later.

picker.title: Who do you want to be?
picker.subtitleFor: {app} is asking which of your identities to continue with.
picker.subtitleGeneric: Choose which of your identities to continue with.
picker.refusedHint: The app that sent you here did not give a destination we recognise, so there is nowhere safe to return you to. Nothing has changed about your account.
picker.cancel: Not now — go back without choosing

notFound.title: We could not find that page
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or what was here is no longer available.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We could not load your identity. This is a problem on our side, not with your account — your sign-in is unaffected.
